title: Author a Mapping

narrative_arc.enters_knowing: They have a CSVW at a public URL and an ontology pattern. They want a YARRRML mapping.
narrative_arc.leaves_knowing: The full 9-step authoring cycle with real API shapes at every step, the quality gate, and upload to CKAN.
steps: What MapToMethod does — 'compiler' metaphor: data structure + ontology pattern → mapping rules
Prerequisites — CSVW URL, pattern URL, both publicly accessible
Step 1: GET /api/types on CSVW — inline real response (5 type IRIs)
Step 2: GET /api/entities on CSVW — inline real response (3 column entities including table-1-LengthMm)
Step 3: GET /api/entities on pattern with owl:NamedIndividual filter
Step 4: Build map dict — inline example JSON pairing column name to template IRI
Step 5: POST /api/mapping — inline first 20 lines of generated YARRRML
Step 7: POST /api/test — diagnostic run before full conversion
Step 8: POST /api/createrdf — inline Turtle output snippet
Step 9: Upload to CKAN mappings group — exact steps
Troubleshooting — rules_skipped > 0 case with best_match fallback

live_api_calls: POST https://rdfconverter.matolab.org/api/checkmapping with IOFMaterialsTutorial CSVW and mapping

primary.name: Data Engineer
knows: Tabular data and data transformation concepts
does_not_know: RDF, triples, or the semantic web stack
YARRRML, RML, or any mapping language
What a named graph or blank node is
primary.goal: Connect data sources, author mappings, and query transformation results.
primary.key_gap: Solid general engineering skills but semantic web is completely foreign. Every RDF/SPARQL/YARRRML concept must be explained from first principles — do not assume any prior semantic knowledge.
